macaria.desc: Heroine, daughter of Hercules. Adult young woman, athletic with well-defined muscle, long blond hair, fair Mediterranean skin. Wears a short white-and-gold Greek chiton/tunic with leather belt and sandals. FMG subject — grows huge twice.

hercules.desc: Father, ~40, classic Greek hero. Well-muscled but NOT huge (lean heroic, not a bodybuilder). Short dark beard, dark wavy hair, bronzed skin. Brown leather/tunic warrior garb, sandals, maybe a lion-skin nod. Gets beaten by the monsters mid-story (battered/limping later).

cyclops.desc: FEMALE Cyclops monster. 7ft tall, very muscular, single large central eye, ONE earring, carries a heavy club. Tough leather/hide outfit. Mid-story drinks a stolen potion and grows even larger muscles + breasts than Macaria's first form, growing out of her clothes (torn remnants cover). Secondary transforming antagonist.

env_hercules_home.desc: Interior of Hercules' ancient-Greek home — stone walls, simple wooden table + chairs, clay bowls/amphorae, doorway with daylight, rustic hero's dwelling. DAZ3D Iray.

env_greek_village.desc: Ancient Greek village square mid-destruction — whitewashed stone houses, market stalls, overturned wagons, smashed barrels, dust, scattered debris. The battleground. DAZ3D Iray.

growth_metadata.macaria: Two-stage FMG. Pages 6-8: athletic -> 7ft muscle mountain (battle form, lineup tier ~4, scraps of chiton). Pages 16-17: grows AGAIN, even bigger than grown Cyclops (lineup tier 6), torn remnants. Monotonic: never shrinks until story-end 'back to normal' line (p20, off-page).
